scope: 120 early source-sheet entries; proposed game metadata only.
semantics: All role, four-element type and physical/heavy/magic labels in this file are authored prototype design, not official reference facts or an official moveset.
Existing forms 1–66 retain their committed profiles, names, skills and edges when merged. Proposed metadata here does not overwrite those bindings.
Source-game stage selects the authored combat tier; this is separate from official-reference stage and numeric training level.
Distinct source visual variants keep their own entry keys. Alias/variant correspondence cautions in the official metadata remain unresolved where marked.
